title: Teko ea Lenyora
intro: Sechaba, se neng se labalabela boetapele ho sireletsa sepheo sa sona, se ile sa kopa hore ho behoe molaoli oa sona. Ha kopo ea bona e arajoa, mokhethoa o ile a hanyetsoa ke lipelaelo, hobane motho enoa o ne a se na boemo ba lefatše boo a neng a bo lebeletse. Pele ho ntoa ea ho qetela, moetapele enoa e mocha o ne a tla leka taeo ea lebotho ka teko e bonolo, empa e tebileng ea thibelo.
clues: Ke ile ka khethoa ho ba molaoli ka mor'a hore batho ba heso ba batle moetapele ea tla loana molemong oa Allah.
Batho ba bangata ba heso ba ile ba qala ho belaella ho khethoa ha ka, ba bolela hore ha ke na leruo ebile ha ke na leloko le hlomphehang.
Ke khethiloe hobane Allah o ne a mphile tsebo e ngata le bolelele bo matla ba 'mele.
Pontšo e hlakileng ea ho khethoa ha ka ke Molimo e ne e le ho khutla ha Areka ea Selekane, e jereng ke mangeloi, e ileng ea tlisa khotso lipelong tsa balumeli.
Ha ke ntse ke tsamaea le masole a ka, ke ile ka phatlalatsa hore re tla lekoa haufi le noka.
Ke laetse lebotho la ka hore mang kapa mang ea noang metsi a mangata nokeng e ne e se oa sehlopha sa ka, athe ba nkang khaba e le 'ngoe feela ka letsoho ba ne ba tla sala.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
